_comment: Study-class policy: these rules protect the tooling boundary (CLAUDE.md), not data sensitivity. Reusable data access and wrangling belongs in chalkboard.eda; study sessions consume the package and never write to it — hence the checkout is readable via additionalDirectories but denied for edit/write. The client-template rules grounded in client-data sensitivity (Read denials on data/, output/, scratch/, and the Rscript ask gate) do not carry over: this repo holds public data. Pushing is denied outright, not prompted: agent sessions commit locally and flag the pending push (study-* class rule). These rules bind agent sessions only — they have no effect on the user's own terminal. Per-machine overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).
